name: skills
description: Get production-ready images, video, audio, and 3D from any AI agent: skills that pick the right model, price before spending, and keep characters and brands consistent through the Scenario MCP, plus expert teams that drive Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Unreal, and Unity.
one_liner: Lets an AI agent generate images, video, and 3D art that actually look like the same brand or character every time, instead of a different random style each run.
buyer: A small ad agency or indie game studio's art director who needs a steady stream of on-brand visuals but can't afford a full-time artist.
business_use_cases: A small agency produces a week's worth of consistent, branded social ad creative (same mascot or product) for several SMB clients at once.
An indie game studio generates consistent character art and 3D assets for a title without hiring a dedicated art team.
An e-commerce brand generates a full week of on-brand product photography variants automatically instead of booking a photo shoot.

money_ideas.idea: A retainer-style 'always-on-brand content' subscription sold to small businesses.
One-off project packages for game studios or brands needing a defined art asset set.

steal_this: Offer a $200/week 'always-on-brand social content' subscription to five local businesses, running them all through one Scenario pipeline this weekend.
